packageRules.description: One weekly PR for all minor and patch updates.
Crawlee updates have broken the prod-only pipeline before (PROJECT_OVERVIEW §11); keep them out of the group and open a PR only on request from the dependency dashboard.

customManagers.description: Docker images pinned by digest in workflow env vars, marked with a '# renovate:' comment (the gitleaks image runs via docker run, which the github-actions manager does not see).
